reports.summary: Interface versus implementation: cache-stability 10/136, lease 15/351, storage-types 7/62, storage 22/536 (pub items / non-blank non-comment implementation lines). lease and storage are deep; storage-types is shallow by design. No Strong candidate.

candidates.title: Retire the PostgreSQL backend variation
candidates.implementation: `label()` arm, `open_sqlite` unsupported-backend arm, `postgres_database_name` and its private `fnv1a_hex`, five `#[cfg(feature = "sqlite")]` sites

deletion_test.rationale: Deleting the variation makes the complexity vanish rather than move: no call site in the host source constructs `StorageBackend::Postgres` (0 hits), and no adapter exists in this workspace once the PostgreSQL backend is dropped.

candidates.rationale: Not Strong: the candidate removes surface rather than deepening a module, so the interface-versus-implementation metric does not apply. Blocked in U2 by R18: `crates/storage-types/tests/golden/storage_vectors.json` pins `postgres_database_name` for seven module ids and the U2 test scenario requires the fixture byte-identical. Retirement is a separately reviewed contract change that replaces the fixture; the `eidnara_` prefix is frozen in the registry until then.
candidates.follow_up: contract change after U2; no bead exists yet because the source repositories stay authoritative until U8

candidates.title: Single FNV-1a implementation

deletion_test.rationale: Deleting either copy moves it: storage-types must stay free of a filesystem-lock dependency and lease must not depend on descriptor types, so the shared home would be a new crate for six lines.

candidates.rationale: The storage-types copy exists only for `postgres_database_name`; C1 removes it.

candidates.title: Merge GuardedConn and MaintenanceConn forwarding

deletion_test.rationale: A shared inner handle would hand the guarded callback `execute_batch` and `pragma_update`, or take `changes` from it. The duplication is the capability boundary that `a_read_callback_cannot_clear_the_read_only_guard` (`crates/storage/src/lib.rs:1299`) and `a_callback_cannot_end_the_fence_checked_transaction` (`:1355`) depend on.

candidates.rationale: Call sites that show the complexity moves rather than concentrates: every consumer callback in the host source's store passes through `with_conn` or `with_conn_fenced` and must not gain batch or pragma capability; merging the handles reshuffles the same forwarding while widening the guarded surface.

candidates.title: Remove the migration runner
candidates.interface: `storage::open_sqlite(descriptor, baseline)`: one DDL text per store
candidates.implementation: pristine detection, baseline application, identity verification, and refusal without mutation

deletion_test.rationale: Deleting the runner removes the version ledger, the per-namespace watermark, ordering rules, and three authorizer targets; what remains is one identity check the open already needed.

candidates.rationale: Accepted: a store has exactly one schema, so the runner, the `Migration` type, and the version ledger are surface without a second implementation. The open applies the baseline to a pristine file and refuses any other identity, which is smaller than the runner it replaces and closes the forged-ledger class of escapes.
candidates.property_impact: `store-schema-identity-matches-the-baseline` replaces the fence-table identity record and the per-namespace migration record: a fresh file equals the inventory fixture and a mismatched file is refused without mutation. `protected-write-set-is-fence-complete` and `read-callbacks-cannot-write` lose their migration arms and gain the format_marker target.
candidates.implementation_evidence: `crates/storage/src/lib.rs`: `open_sqlite(descriptor, baseline)`, `ExpectedIdentity::{for_baseline, classify, apply}`, `crates/storage/baseline.sql`; tests `fresh_file_matches_the_baseline_inventory`, `a_consumer_baseline_is_applied_once_and_verified_on_reopen`, `a_file_with_foreign_objects_is_refused_without_mutation`, `a_baseline_that_does_not_apply_is_rejected_before_the_file_is_touched`; `scripts/eidnara-migration/check.ts` rejects migration machinery tokens in non-test code.
candidates.final_verdict: Implemented: `storage` has no `Migration` type, runner, or version ledger; a fresh file's identity equals `fixtures/schema/storage-inventory-v1.json` and a mismatched file is refused without mutation.
